notes.title: Typing Ninja - Official Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920937/3a645d1f3fb502bef681ee92173f61555b1435a1.png[/img]

[h1]🎉Typing Ninja launches on April 9, 2025!🎉[/h1]

[h2]⚔️ Master the Art of Ninja Typing! 🥷💻[/h2]

🔥 Key Features:
✅ 6-Level Story Mode – Conquer your fear of technology!
✅ 5 Difficulty Levels – Peaceful (for kids & slow typers), Easy, Mid, Hard, Impossible!
✅ Multiple Survival Modes – Boss fights, power-ups, and roguelike challenges!
✅ Roguelike Mode – Face 10+ unique bosses!
✅ 5+ Game Modes – Endless ways to train and compete!
✅ Custom Practice – Type your own words & improve skills!
✅ Chillax Mode – Control word length, speed, and more for a stress-free experience!

[h2]💡 Try our free demo now and share your feedback![/h2]
